faqs.question: What is BDes Fashion Design Course?
faqs.answer: The Bachelor of Design in Fashion or BDes Fashion Design focuses on offering knowledge on designing clothes, accessories, etc. using a computer and manual designing as per the latest style and trend in the fashion industry. The study of designing apparel and accessories is covered in the undergraduate course known as Bachelor of Design (Fashion Design) or BDes Fashion Design. A 4-year undergraduate degree programme in Fashion Design leads to the designation of "Bachelor of Design in Fashion Design" (BDes Fashion Design). It is a professional degree that equips students with the abilities and information required to plan, develop, and manufacture apparel and accessories. Students get knowledge on how to sketch outfits and accessories, fashionably make patterns and design textiles. Candidates who have a strong interest in fashion and design can pursue this course. They must keep up with the most recent trend and possess artistic skills and must be imaginative and inventive. Candidates must also be skilled at resolving issues. Fashion Designers must be able to think critically and act rapidly. After pursuing this course, candidates will be able to face the challenges that come with this career if they are adept at solving problems. faqs.question: What is the difference between B.Des and B.Sc in fashion design? Which is the best course among them?
faqs.answer: Hi, some of the basic differences between a BSc and BDes in Fashion Design is, first the course focus. A BSc programme is more focused on the technical and scientific elements of fashion production , such as its fabric properties and manufacturing processes. Meanwhile BDes is focused on the artistic and creative side of the Design . Therefore, their course curriculum and syllabus also differs. In a BSc Fashion Design, you'll find more technical subjects, including  fashion theories, fashion psychology, and sociological choice of clothing . Meanwhile, in a BDes programme you'll find subjects like illustration, pattern making, draping, and garment construction . Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: How to prepare for BDes Fashion Design entrance exams?
faqs.answer: There are several ways through which you can prepare well for BDes Fashion Design entrance exams. You must become proficient in English, quantitative reasoning, logic and reasoning. In order to improve their time management skills and gain knowledge of the exam question format, you can use the previous year's question papers as a resource and participate in mock exams. You may also consult a variety of marketable reference books by well-known authors.

faqs.question: Can I get admission to BDes Fashion Design in IITs through UCEED?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can get admission to BDes Fashion Design course in several IITs that offer the course, through UCEED exam. The exam is conducted by IIT Bombay every year. There are six IITs that accept UCEED score for admission to BDes courses. These are IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Hyderabad,  IIITDM Jabalpur and IIT Roorkee.

faqs.question: What is the difference between NIFT and UCEED?
faqs.answer: The National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) entrance examination is an Institutional based examination that will only help you to get into the National Institute of Fashion Technology whereas the Undergraduate common entrance exam for design UCEED is a common Entrance Examination which is accepted by many design colleges and universities. The NIFT is an autonomous institute that offers courses in fashion, design, technology, and management. NIFT's head office is located in New Delhi, India. The UCEED is an entrance examination conducted by IIT, Bombay. It is a joint entrance examination for admission into B. Des programme at IIT Bombay, IIT Guwahati, and IITD Jabalpur. I hope this will help you.

faqs.question: Is it possible to crack NID DAT without coaching?
faqs.answer: It is not mandatory to take coaching to get a good rank in NID DAT. It is because the entrance exam will test the creative, drawing, and innovative skills of the candidate. Now, a coaching institute cannot exactly teach you to be creative or become innovative. Instead, with a little effort these skills can learn these skills yourself. Also, a major thrust of the design aptitude test is to evaluate the drawing skills of the candidate. So, make it a point to work on your design skills, including learning how to draw lines, shadow, figure, gesture, cartoon drawing, etc. When practicing drawing, also keep a tab on the drawing speed, as it will help you complete the paper in the allotted time.

faqs.question: What is the mode and exam pattern of FDDI AIST?
faqs.answer: FDDI AIST 2026 entrance exam will be conducted as a paper-based exam and will be of 3 hours. The question paper will be multiple choice based. B.Des paper will include questions from topics like Quantitative Aptitude, Verbal Ability, General Awareness, and Business Aptitude Test & Design Aptitude Test. Candidates need to follow the exam pattern when preparing for the exam. Also, make sure to stick to the official syllabus and important topics.

full_content.text: BDes Fashion Design Admission Process 2025
To get admission to a BDes in Fashion Design course , you must go through several steps involved in the admission process. For your reference, here's a general guide.

rows.Details: The primary step is to check the eligibility criteria of your desired college. Admission to this program requires the candidate to pass Class 12 from any stream (Science, Commerce, and Arts) with a minimum of 55% aggregate score from a recognised board.
The next step is to see the entrance exams conducted by your desired colleges and appear for them. Fill out the online application form, prepare for the exam, and appear for it.
Stay updated regarding the result dates of the entrance exam and visit the official site to see the results. Aspirants can also download their scorecards.

Some institutes like NIFTs and NIDs may also conduct GDPI (Group Discussion or Personal Interview) rounds to shortlist candidates for admission. Design candidates also might need to provide a portfolio to showcase their projects, achievements, or work experience (if any).

Based on the score or rank, a candidate becomes eligible for counselling or admission rounds. Fill out the choice forms indicating the preferred colleges and courses, and attend the counselling session.

Once the seat is allocated, complete the admission formalities such as fee payment, document verification process, and more. Candidates who have been provisionally selected are required to undergo document verification, further having their admission guaranteed.

questions.question_text: What is the format of MAH B.Design Exam 2026?

answers.answer_text: MAH B.Design will have PART A & B :- Sketching skill based, Problem solving ability Time (1 Hr. 45 Minutes) PART C :- MCQs based questions (Time 60 Minutes). The exam will be of 200 marks.

questions.question_text: Is APAAR ID required to fill the MAH CET 2026 B.Design Application?

answers.answer_text: Yes, APAAR ID required to fill the MAH CET 2026 B.Design Application. Aadhaar ID is also required to register. Candidates who have not generated their APAAR ID are required to create one through DigiLocker

questions.question_text: Is MAH CET B.Design Application 2026 open?

answers.answer_text: Yes, the registration forms for MAH CET B.Design are open for 2026. It is open from January 22,  2026 to February 24,  2026. The exams will be on April 05,  2026.

questions.question_text: When is the last date to fill the MAH CET B.design Application 2026?

answers.answer_text: MAH CET B.Design 2026 Application is open now. The application is open from January 22,  2026 to February 24,  2026. The forms are available on the website of MAH CET.

tags.tag_name: National Institute of Fashion Technology, Mumbai

answers.answer_text: NIFT Mumbai offers a BDes programme at the UG level. It is offered in full-time mode and across several specialisations. The total tuition fee of BDes at NIFT camous Mumbai ranges between INR 5.6 Lacs and INR 13 lakh.

tags.tag_name: National Institute of Fashion Technology, Mumbai

answers.answer_text: NIFT Mumbai offers BDes course to students at the UG level. It is offered for 4 years in several specialisations. To be eligible for BDes at National Institute of Fashion and Technology, candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria set by the college. questions.question_text: Is BDes admission at NIF Global Jaipur entrance-based or merit-based?

answers.answer_text: Admission to the BDes course at NIF Global Jaipur is completely merit-based. Firstly, candidates are required to complete their Class 12 in any stream. Then, the college releases the merit list of shortlisted applicants according to their achieved scores in Class 12.

questions.question_text: Does NIF Global Jaipur accept the CUET scores for admission to BDes course?

answers.answer_text: No, NIF Global Jaipur does not accept CUET scores for enrollment into BDes course. The college accepts the scores of Class 12 for admission to this course. Students should complete their Class 12 from any recognised board in any stream with decent scores. After evaluating applicants' scores, the college releases the merit list.
